newsitem.title: USA: MedImmune says MEDI-493 generally safe.
newsitem.headline: MedImmune says MEDI-493 generally safe.

text.p: MedImmune Inc Monday said initial results from clinical trials of its MEDI-493 showed that the drug, a monoclonal antibody being developed to fight respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) disease in children, was generally safe and well tolerated.
The company said that to date nine Phase I and Phase I/II clinical studies of the drug have been completed in six countries involving about 300 patients.
It said it was disclosing data compiled from the first four Phase I clinical studies in 38 healthy adult volunteers.
Results from the initial studies also showed there were no no significant immune responses observed against the antibody itself, it said.

Franklin Top Jr., executive vice president and medical director of the company, said that with the data from the first four Phase I trials in hand, MedImmune conducted an additional five Phase I/II studies in infants during the fall of 1995 and throughout 1996.
Those studies have all been completed, results are being analyzed and will be reported over the next several months," he said.
